title: VTS traffic report contradicted by observations

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is Harbour VTS. INFORMATION. The fairway is clear. You may proceed inbound. Over.
events.expected_response: Recognise that tracked OUTBOUND contradicts the report, seek clarification where practicable, and continue an independently safe response.
events.forbidden_outcome: Proceeding on the unsupported assumption that the fairway is clear while OUTBOUND remains observed.
